name: ossify
description: Skeleton-first lifecycle from Release 0 through MVP and v1, replacing scaffold-onboard + scaffold-dev, not staging alongside them. workspace-init is optional: /ossify:start and /ossify:adopt author .ossify/topology.json themselves, and a workspace-init pairing manifest is read as a fallback when one exists. Self-sufficient: grill/critic ship as /ossify:challenge (configurable adversary). /ossify:start onboards a project, /ossify:adopt an existing repo, /ossify:plan-release and /ossify:plan-spine plan the work, /ossify:run-spine drives the rounds, /ossify:close runs the ceremony, /ossify:doctor diagnoses, /ossify:wayfinder charts decision tickets, plus the any-repo /ossify:handoff and /ossify:work-pr.
